verdict.rationale: Stark Bank publishes an API reference with per-language examples (Python, Node, PHP, Java, Ruby, Elixir, C#, Go, Clojure, Curl), plus a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 YAML and a first-party Postman collection. A self-serve Sandbox workspace lets users actually run those requests, so runnable examples exist, but through external tooling rather than a demonstrated interactive reference. The probe's 404s on JSON OpenAPI paths do not contradict the documented YAML download. Missing for 10: an in-browser interactive 'try it' console in the reference itself, evidence that the examples are executable in place, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
